Ptrs05EC00.name: Level data: sprite pointers and entrance tables
summary: Pointer table at $05EC00: 512 16-bit pointers (bank $07), one per level number, to that level's sprite list (first byte = header: bits 0-5 sprite memory, bits 6-7 buoyancy).
Shared pointer $E76D = empty list. Read in the level loader at CODE_05D8EB using [$0E]*2.
Then eight 512-byte tables indexed by level/entrance number: $05F000 (Mario start Y, level setup), $05F200 (X start, fade effect $1BE3),
$05F400 (screen Y and layer 2 start bits), $05F600 (vertical level flag [$5B], layer 2 flag $141F, X screen).
$05F800-$05FE00 are used instead when $1B93 is non-zero (secondary entrance): level number, Y, X, extra bits. Bit meanings partly inferred.
